summary: PO 2023 section 7: 113 ECTS compulsory basic phase, then in the main phase Data Science, Studienarbeit, Project III and a 15-ECTS internship, plus 7 ECTS from the elective Schlüsselkompetenzen Wahlbereich. The compulsory 3 ECTS module Einführung in Betriebswirtschaftslehre und Fabrikbetrieb is not offered this semester. One specialization of six is chosen in an individually approved specialization plan, with 12 ECTS specific foundations, 12 ECTS basic modules and 18 ECTS advanced modules. The checklist cannot link the two specialization rules to the same specialization, cannot split basic from advanced modules, and cannot enforce the 6-ECTS Integrationsfächer cap in Mensch - Organisation - Technik. Nachhaltige Fahrzeugtechnik specific foundations are not offered this semester. Main phase exams require 90 ECTS from the basic phase.
